visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with styled light brown hair and a white t-shirt featuring 101 Dalmatians dog illustrations holds a colorful instant noodle package directly in front of the lens. Her facial expression is vibrant and she smiles broadly while adjusting her hair and looking directly at the camera. (2) The scene transitions to a well-lit kitchen. The woman stands before the camera, gesturing with her hands while explaining a cooking concept. She wears gold-toned Chanel earrings and has a light blue and white baseball-style shirt on. The background shows kitchen cabinetry, a range hood, and household items. (3) Close-up montage shots focus on a black air fryer basket. Hands carefully place chopped green cabbage leaves at the bottom, then place a round block of dry noodles on top. Seasoning packets are torn open and the red powder is sprinkled over the noodles. (4) A red ceramic bowl is shown with a raw egg inside, which is then poured into the center of the air fryer basket. A blue mug is used to pour clear water over the ingredients. The camera angle is top-down, showing the layering of the cabbage, noodles, and egg. (5) The woman interacts with a white Philips air fryer, turning the silver dial to set the temperature to 170 degrees and the timer to 12 minutes. Her hands feature a sparkling silver manicure. She gives a thumbs-up to the camera with an eager facial expression. (6) In a living room setting, a man dressed in a black t-shirt is seen lying horizontally on a grey fabric sofa. He appears exhausted and looks toward the camera with a slightly hungry expression. Plush toys, including Winnie the Pooh and Pikachu, are scattered on the sofa behind him. (7) The woman opens the air fryer drawer, revealing the noodles are cooked but some cabbage leaves on the edges look scorched and black. She tilts her head back and laughs heartily, looking directly into the camera while showing the partially burnt result. (8) The woman and man sit closely together at a dining table. They are both looking into the air fryer basket and using chopsticks to lift and inspect the noodles. The man examines the texture critically while the woman continues to laugh and smile at the camera.
